description: Machine-readable live work queue. Passing entries are retained for 24 hours, then removed by pnpm features:prune; durable behavior and evidence remain in product specs and Git/PR history. See docs/FEATURES.md for rules.

features.behavior: Plan 0010 slice 1 (security, details in private advisory): SQL console statement handling and download-grant scoping are hardened; new conformance cases verified across Postgres, MySQL, and SQLite (MongoDB not applicable).
features.verification: pnpm --filter @qyre/driver-contract test && pnpm --filter @qyre/testing-conformance test && pnpm --filter @qyre/server test && pnpm verify:pr
features.evidence: PR https://github.com/ensp1re/qyre/pull/186 CI green on 9032869 (Lint, typecheck, test, build; End-to-end incl. MongoDB). Locally: Postgres 16 + MySQL 8 unit/integration/conformance, Playwright smoke 9/9 and full 26 passed (remaining failures environment-only, identical on main).
